paragraphs: Twenty years in waterworks distribution, trade contracting, and commercial construction, on both the operations and revenue side.

As Vice President, Internal Operations at Gibson Plumbing, ran purchasing, warehousing, fleet, facilities, IT, warranty, and risk management through six department heads as revenue roughly tripled. P&L experience jointly on a $20M distribution branch and as an owner of two companies. Since 2022, I have sold SUNVEK Roofing's most complex commercial work, with full pricing and scope authority on my own projects.
Built departments, an IT team, SOPs, a manufacturers' sales representative network, and two companies.

consulting.text: I take on project-based operations and plumbing consulting through Dangart Group. If you have an interesting idea, problem, or project, I would like to hear about it.

results.text: Ran Gibson's internal operations as revenue tripled, from roughly $27M to a projected $80M+, across the San Antonio, Austin, DFW, and Houston markets.

Annual material purchasing grew from $16M to over $36M; negotiated and signed all vendor discount and rebate agreements. A direct shipment program saved 30% on fittings in its first year. Ran a 35,000 sq ft warehouse, completed 11 physical inventories, and brought a fleet of over eighty vehicles into DOT compliance.
Built a national manufacturers' rep network at Dangart, led a branch sales team at Fortiline, and created SUNVEK's technical sales training materials.
Joint P&L responsibility for a $20M distribution branch, and owner-level P&L in two companies.
Responsible for Gibson's non-revenue KPIs, wrote the BI dashboards used by every executive, and led the SAGE 100 ERP implementation.

roles.intro: Hired to manage the Purchasing and Warehousing departments, then created and managed the Technology, Warranty & Safety, Risk Mitigation & Litigation, and Fleet & Facilities Management departments.
roles.summary: Ran purchasing, warehousing, fleet, facilities, IT, warranty, and risk while revenue grew roughly 3x.

bullets.text: Managed six department heads across purchasing, warehouse, warranty, fleet, facilities, and technology, up from three at hire. Hired and trained several people into their first technical roles; two went on to become a software engineer at Amazon and an AI engineer at JPMorgan Chase.
Created the procedures for inventory tracking, receiving, cycle counts, pull sheets, material returns, and tool checkout, and completed 11 physical inventories.

Responsible for the company's non-revenue KPIs (purchasing, labor and materials as a percentage of sales, warranty, fleet). Wrote the BI dashboards used by every executive and hired a data scientist for the executive team.

Annual material purchasing grew from $16M to over $36M. Directly negotiated vendor discounts and rebates and signed the agreements, including a five-year national supply agreement and a national fixture rebate agreement. Created the direct shipment program (30% savings on fittings in its first year), and in 2021 held Gibson's costs flat through one manufacturer's market increase and another's third increase of the year.

Ran package assembly and an in-house fabrication shop supplying about 3,000 houses a year: rough-in, top-out, and trim kits built to templates, with a time study of every warehouse task. I have not run a full production plant.
Ran a 35,000 sq ft warehouse. Fleet strategy for maintenance, aging, and acquisitions across more than eighty vehicles, brought into DOT compliance. Three office expansions.

Led the SAGE 100 ERP implementation in 2017 (conversion from Contractor's Dream, 3,000 to 5,000 part numbers, new templates, inventory migration), then brought warranty, scheduling, inspections, and material checkout into the system. Created the IT department and a software team of three developers plus a data scientist from scratch. Custom internal and customer-facing applications (work-ticket creation, material checkout, crew QA) saved over 5,000 person-hours in 2020.
Held warranty overhead growth to half the rate of revenue growth. Oversaw all litigation, mediation, and subrogation as the designated company representative for depositions.

Invited to exchange inventory and software practices with two peer contractors. In April 2019, spent several days on-site at Ridgeway Plumbing, one of Florida's largest plumbing contractors, and brought back daily cycle counting and the move to a SQL back end. A second exchange, with Kimbel Mechanical in Arkansas, was cancelled by COVID.
